title: Anduril: access, ownership, and the government gate
dek: A sequenced public-record packet for testing how Anduril's acquired stack, access signals, formal government gates, and counterexamples line up. The sequence, evidence matrix, controls, and reporting queue expose the work without generating a narrative conclusion.

history.change: Initial finite reporter briefing compiled from the receipted Anduril case.
Replace pseudo-precise coordinates with categorical placement and add a canonical decision sequence, evidence matrix, counterweights, claim register, and sequenced reporting queue.

workplan.title: Reconstruct the formal gate before chasing access

Testing, acceptance, successful-completion, baseline, and transition records

workplan.title: Pin access to the exact decision window

Ethics advice, recusals, waivers, participation screens, and conflict controls

Which person must approve exactly what, and at which point in the mission.
Whether the government can remove Anduril and preserve the same mission without vendor-led reintegration.
Which data, interfaces, credentials, permissions, and operational state the vendor controls.
Whether the process is qualified and has demonstrated yield, accepted deliveries, and mission-capable inventory.
